question: Which of the following statements for Piezoelectric transducer is correct?

options.text: Piezoelectric transducer can be used for the measurement of static displacement only.
Piezoelectric transducer can be used for the measurement of dynamic displacement only
Piezoelectric transducer can be used for the measurement of both static and dynamic displacement.
Piezoelectric transducer cannot be used for the measurement of both static and dynamic displacement.

solution:
The correct answer is __Piezoelectric transducer can be used for the measurement of dynamic displacement only**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Piezoelectric transducer__ is used to measure dynamic parameters.
 
• It works based on the piezoelectric effect, which generates an electrical charge in response to mechanical stress.
 
• This transducer is not suitable for static displacement measurement due to charge leakage over time.
 
• Applications include measuring vibration, pressure, and acceleration in dynamic systems.
 
• Piezoelectric materials used include quartz, ceramics, and certain polymers.
 
• The transducer provides high sensitivity and accuracy for dynamic measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Advantages:**
 
 
• High-frequency response enables accurate measurement of dynamic parameters.
 
• Compact size and ease of installation.
 
• Wide range of applications in industrial and scientific fields.
 
 
 
• **Limitations:**
 
 
• Cannot measure static displacement due to charge leakage.
 
• Requires careful handling to avoid damage to the piezoelectric material.
